description:
Local LLM API proxy with automatic channel failover.

OSW (One Switch) runs a proxy on your machine. Register every channel you have - different providers, accounts, and models - order them the way they should be tried, and point every AI client at a single local address. OSW identifies the protocol, picks a channel, moves on when one fails, and records exactly what happened. Your client only ever sees the attempt that succeeded.
New
- console: sign the request report with OSW and its homepage
- console: add copy-request and error-report actions to the contents sheet
Fixed
- app: start Electron only after the first build of every watcher finishes
- console: speak only for the upstream attempt in the contents sheet
- release: publish the CLI to npm inside release.yml
Changed
- request-logs: collapse the live-row rule to two cases
- unify the workspace scope and trim the dev/build scripts
- console: regroup the settings page around what each section answers
- console: rename the error report to a request report
- console: rebuild the contents-sheet footer buttons on the design-system button group
- console: pin the contents-sheet actions to a bottom footer and drop local ids from the facts
